blocks.text: “Lets take a quick look of what shall be as we are definitely near the climax of the age! Mystery and suspense will abound! Sudden and violent changes concerning nature and society. An age of the hidden and the exposure of the deadliest of sins will arise! The extreme – fantasy replacing reality! A dream world that turns into a nightmare!” “According to the Scriptural and prophetic foresight, we are headed for a flood of events even before this age ends. And according to Rev. 18: 8-10 judgment will come in one day and in one hour upon the last Babylon. Of course the world will be included in this swiftness of judgment.” – “Jesus said it is a sign.” (Luke 21:20, 22, 25) “And what He said will occur!” Now let’s take a look at some of the events that lead up to those Scriptures. Last month we said we would cover economic events, defaults and the debts and a close look at the Roman Empire and the U.S. Empire. – U.S. debt default will be a worldwide disaster. As we know several major countries have been buying the U.S. debt, but are now realizing that there is no way the U.S. can pay all of the trillions and trillions of dollars it has borrowed. They are attempting to devalue the dollar in order to pay these countries back with a cheaper currency. A similar event took place with Germany. Until they had a currency, it would not buy a loaf of bread, even if you had a wheelbarrow full of it. That event took place in less than 3 1/2 years. At the speed that computers work today it will take less time than that. It is very difficult to put all the needed ingredients in this letter due to the space that is required, but I will try to lay a foundation of these events subject by subject. – At this hour they are trying to save the economy and the debts of Greece and many more countries involved in the European Union. All of these countries were involved in the derivative market. It is now said by a leading economist that the derivative market is larger than all the central banks put together. Those that create them are causing great havoc to all currencies. They are targeting all nations taking huge profits from all currencies. This is evident in the price of gold and silver, oil and all resources.

Before we go any further we will take a look at the failure of the Roman Empire and the coming failure of the Western World. It all started with the growth of Rome. They found the empire so large that the growth of the obligations to take care of the army, the government workers and the expansion program that they were in could not be met by ordinary income. So they started a borrowing program to keep up with all the benefits and the entitlements. They began to borrow from their retirement funds to pay the workers with their own retirement money, promising to pay back the money when times got better. That put them on a road of no return. At one point 50 denarii would pay for the cost of an average families’ annual food needs. By the time the Roman Empire collapsed the cost of that same standard was over 6,000 denarii. Many countries, including the U.S. are looking at borrowing the retirement funds from the federal workers. – Doesn’t this sound familiar? That has put them on the same road of no return. The one thing that the modern world has is printing press money. This will end in a worse and faster way than the Roman Empire ended in. I’m going take a look at a barometer that will point to the coming disaster. Gold is that barometer making a way for the anti- Christ to make his appearance on the world scene. He will have control of all resources. His friends and associates will control the oil, food and the new banking currency that will be arriving. We know by the Scriptures and Brother Frisby’s scroll writings that he will be affiliated with the Catholic Church, Israel and all Arabic nations as well as Russia, China and all Asian nations. Naturally the Western World is with him as well. The USA is found in the second beast! (Rev. 13:11-13) – A large number of economists are now pointing to $12,000 to $14,000 gold. They are hoping that this will cover a large portion of the U.S. dollar debt that has accumulated. But in the end the new currency will be backed by gold thereby allowing the anti- Christ to place a mark upon the people of the world to buy or sell. (Rev. 13:16,17) It will be like Nebuchadnezzar’s head of gold. (Dan. 3:1-6) You can only trade, buy or sell according to the gold standard that he has placed upon the currency. The number of the gold standard will be 999, for that is the number of gold. So by now we can see how out of all the coming chaos he will be able to implement his master plan. (Dan. 8:25) Now is the time to do all that you can for the gospel work for He will truly reward those who have faithfully witnessed and supported the gospel of the Lord Jesus Christ! This month I have a wonderful new Special Writing Book, Volume Eight called “World History and Prophetic Events.” This is a very informative and enlightening book.. We also have a new DVD called “Sound Words.” (See offer below.) – I would like to also mention that we are having a representative go to many countries where we have sent a lot of literature ahead of time. The material will be distributed during their meetings. Your help in this great project will be a blessing for those people who receive Brother Neal Frisby’s material. Your support and prayers have been wonderful. May Jesus guide and bless each and every one of you. Your Brother in Christ,
